card.name: Linking words in drug discovery passages
card.fires_on: Small linking words (by, from, to, of, and, at) and year digits in text about how drugs or compounds were discovered, derived or developed. The next word is likely to be a compound or chemical agent.

modes.label: Discovery and origin links
modes.description: A preposition after a verb of discovery, derivation or tracing, in passages about where drugs come from.
modes.example: which were discovered<< by>> clinical observation.

modes.label: Years in drug-access history
modes.description: The digit inside a year such as 2000 or 2001 in text about AIDS drug pricing.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like compound, screening, docking and scaffold, which are drug-chemistry terms.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in text about how drugs were found or developed, as if a word like compound might come next.
